body:
Ava: Quick Q2 OKR tidy-up — can folks drop what shipped/slipped and next steps for the 'Smart routing & fallbacks' milestone? Need final rollout plan by EOW. @Ravi @Maya :eyes:
Ravi: Shipped: baseline routing rules + canary traffic split yesterday. Slipped: automated fallback to small-quant models (blocked by perf regression). Next: investigate perf delta, aim to have a trimmed quantized variant by Thu. Owner: Ravi.
Maya: On the code side, CRs:
- PR #4281 (routing cleanup) — landed
- PR #4293 (kv-cache compatibility) — needs 1 reviewer
- PR #4302 (quantized variant config) — draft, depends on perf fix
I'm handling reviewers today, ping me for reviews :coffee:
Diego: QA update: canary tests passed for baseline routing (latency + correctness). Regression seen in perf tests for quantized variant: 7% higher tail latency on seq=1024. Test logs: ```/logs/ci/quant_regress_2026-03-15.log``` I can re-run with the new kernel if someone posts the build tag.
Liam: Docs/design note: updated rollout runbook with fallback flow and owner matrix — https://confluence/redwood/okrs/routing-rollout (comments welcome). Need a short diagram to show traffic split states, will do a quick mock this afternoon.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary -> 10% at 2026-03-17T15:00Z. If error-rate > 0.5% auto-rollout will pause.
Ava: Thanks team. Action items I wrote down:
- Ravi: triage perf regression + post findings by Thu EOD
- Maya: finish PR #4302 draft + get reviewer
- Diego: queue re-run once build tag posted
- Liam: add diagram to runbook
I'll compile a one-pager for execs after Thu. If anyone expects delays, flag here. :thumbsup:
